text:
marta: Heads up — two customers on Vercel Edge reported intermittent 401s when a background session refresh happens at the same time as app fetches. Repro steps below, feel free to chime in if you want me to open a repro environment.

alex: Oh. Do you think it's a CORS preflight / cookie ordering thing or something in the TS SDK?

marta: Looks like a race in auth header insertion. Customers see a successful /auth/refresh that sets a cookie, then some in-flight requests land with Authorization: "" (empty) and fail. If they retry immediately they succeed.

julian: Which SDK version on the edge bundle? We had a fix for concurrent token refresh landed in 1.3.0 IIRC.

marta: They're on @redwood/sdk-js 1.2.0 (bundled into Next/Vercel build). One of the customers tried swapping to a local build with 1.3.2 and issue stopped. But we need to be confident and reproduce.

alex: Can you paste a minimal service-worker fetch handler that reproduces?

marta: Sure — here's the simplified handler customer used (they're using a fetch wrapper that calls SDK.getToken() during requests):

```
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  event.respondWith((async () => {
    // background token refresh might run here
    const token = await sdk.getToken(); // may trigger refresh
    const cloned = new Request(event.request, { headers: { ...event.request.headers, 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } });
    return fetch(cloned);
  })());
});
```

marta: Logs show sequence: refresh request -> set-cookie -> concurrent request to /v1/generate -> Authorization header present in the JS layer, but network capture shows header empty on some requests.

alex: Suspicious. Could be request cloning losing headers in the edge runtime or the SDK's getToken returning stale token for a window due to in-progress refresh. In 1.3.x we added an in-flight refresh mutex so only one refresh happens and others wait. 1.2.0 returned an empty string in the token cache while refresh pending (bug).

julian: If that's the case, workaround is to ensure calls wait on sdk.refresh() or to use an atomic locker. But in service workers you often want parallelism. Might be better to ensure sdk.getToken() never returns empty — return previous token until new one confirmed.

marta: Customer also mentioned Vercel Edge sometimes de-duplicates headers when creating new Request() from event.request. Could be edge runtime quirk + SDK bug combined.

support-bot: Ticket created: #T-14892 — Escalation: Vercel Edge intermittent 401s during session refresh. Linked customers: acct-441, acct-723.

sre-oncall: I've spun up a repro using their steps on Vercel Edge preview. Quick notes: with sdk-js@1.2.0 I can repro ~1/10 requests failing when I trigger concurrent refresh + fetch. With 1.3.2 no failures in 500 runs.

alex: OK — plan: 1) Confirmed regression in 1.2.0 -> open patch to make getToken block until refresh completes (or return stale token). 2) Add a small guard in our edge wrapper to avoid constructing Request from event.request headers directly (preserve header set). 3) Add e2e test on Vercel Edge to catch this.

julian: I'll draft a patch for SDK: fallback to previous token while refresh is in-flight, and add a flag to force strict refresh for callers that want it. Also add unit that simulates concurrent callers.

marta: Customer asked for a hotfix or guidance in the meantime. Suggested workaround: pin to 1.3.x in their package or add a short client-side retry (exponential backoff) on 401 for edge fetches. They said retry is acceptable short term.

sre-oncall: Also adding a note in status: we shouldn't call this an outage; it's a client-side SDK race. But we'll push a fast patch to SDK and a follow-up release.

alex: Can you collect a HAR or example Request/Response headers from one failing instance? That will help rule out Vercel header normalization.

marta: Yep, asked customer for HAR and code bundle. I'll attach to ticket once I have it. Thanks all 🙂

julian: I'll start the PR and tag @alex for review. Should be small.

marta: Great — leaving the ticket open for now. If anyone else sees related reports, drop them in this thread.
